scope.gate: flat routed netlist 6_final.v (one module, no mac_int8 hierarchy), sha256 in inputs.routed_netlist_sha256
scope.cell_models: nangate45 cell functions from NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib of the pinned ORFS image (path and sha256 in inputs)
scope.register_correspondence: 806 flops matched by name: operand, skew and valid registers by the RTL name on their Q net; the 512 accumulator bits by the output port bit they drive (acc_o[32*(4*i+j)+b]), since the router renamed their Q nets
scope.cut_points: operand registers (a_q, b_q), skew registers (a_sr, b_sr), valid delay line, primary inputs
scope.partitions: 27 = 16 per-PE cones (accumulator register + 8x8 signed multiplier + 32-bit adder + clear/valid gating, i.e. mac_int8 including the multiplier, once per PE) + 11 wrapper partitions (a_sr, b_sr, a_q, b_q register banks, 6 valid taps, busy)
scope.kind: zero-delay logical (sequential, x-propagating) equivalence per partition; not a timing check

cell_treatment.logic gates, full/half adders, resized g: function taken from the Liberty file; part of the proof and of the simulation
cell_treatment.buffers (BUF_*), incl. timing-repair and: Liberty function Z = A (identity); kept in the netlist, part of the proof and of the simulation
cell_treatment.clock-tree buffers (CLKBUF_*): Liberty function Z = A; simulated as the real clock path in the gate-level simulation; the equivalence proof assumes one global clock, so the clock tree is covered by the separate structural check all_flops_clocked_by_clk (every flop's clock pin resolves to the port clk), not by the SMT proof
cell_treatment.flip-flops (DFF_X1): Liberty ff(IQ, IQN) group, next_state D, clocked_on CK; Yosys builds two identical registers per cell (Q and QN), opt_merge folds them into one; 806 registers remain
cell_treatment.tie cells (LOGIC0/LOGIC1): none instantiated in this netlist (count in netlist_tie_cells)
cell_treatment.fill / tap / antenna cells: not present in 6_final.v: ORFS writes the netlist without physical-only cells, which have no logic pins; nothing was removed by this stage

not_covered: timing of any kind (setup/hold, clock skew, glitches): all checks are zero-delay
physical correctness (DRC, LVS, the GDS itself): only the Verilog netlist 6_final.v is checked
power/ground connectivity (the netlist has no supply pins)
library cells the netlist does not instantiate (cells without a Liberty function are black boxes; the run fails if the netlist uses one)
behaviour before the first clear: registers start undefined in both designs (x-propagating proof; the simulation starts with clear)

eqy_partitions.engine: EQY strategy 'use sby', depth 2, smtbmc bitwuzla (x-propagating miter per partition)

rtl_mac.bug: RTL: acc <= acc + prod + 1 in mac_int8 (checked on PE(0,0))

rtl_reg.rejected_as: counterexample: the solver found an input sequence on which the two sides differ (partitions not equivalent)

netlist.bug: routed netlist: D inputs of a_q[0] and a_q[1] of PE(0,0) swapped
netlist.rejected_as: counterexample: the solver found an input sequence on which the two sides differ (partitions not equivalent)
